Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:10:1.hebrew: בה' לרבות קדשים קלים - להתחייב עליהם קרבן שבועה. אע"ג דאין נשבעין על ההקדשות, והנשבע עליהם והודה אינו מביא אשם של שבועת הפקדון, דוכחש בעמיתו כתיב — הני איתרבו להו מבה', וכחש בעמיתו נמי קרינא בהו, לפי שהן ממונו:
Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:10:1.english: “Against the Lord” to include offerings of lesser sanctity - To become liable on their account for an oath offering. Even though an oath is not administered concerning consecrated property, and one who swears concerning them and [subsequently] confesses does not bring a guilt offering for an oath of deposit, as “and deal falsely with his neighbor” is written — these were included from “against the Lord,” and “and deal falsely with his neighbor” is also read regarding them, since they are his property.

Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:11:1.hebrew: כי קא זכו - בין כהנים בחזה ושוק, בין בעלים בבשר:
Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:11:1.english: When they acquire [it] - Whether the priests [acquiring] the breast and thigh, or the owners [acquiring] the meat.

Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:11:2.english: From the table of the Most High - The offering of the sacrificial portions and the sprinkling of the blood permit the meat [to be eaten].

Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:12:1.hebrew: המקדש בחלקו - לאחר שחלקום, ולא קתני המקדש בקדשים קלים:
Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:12:1.english: One who betroths with his portion - After they divided them, and it does not teach: "One who betroths with offerings of lesser sanctity."

Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:13:2.hebrew: לקפחני - כמו לקפח את שוקיו (סוטה דף מד.) — לקצץ רגלינו בהלכות, להודיע שהם חריפים ואין עומד כנגדם:
Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:13:2.english: To overwhelm me - Like "to cut off his legs" (Sotah 44a) — to cut off our legs in halakhot, to make known that they are sharp and no one [can] stand against them.

Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:14:1.hebrew: וכי אשה בעזרה מנין - דקתני קדשי קדשים, והרי אם יוציאום חוץ לעזרה, אפילו לעזרת נשים, הם נפסלים ביוצא, ונשים אין נכנסות לה, כדתנן באבות הטומאות בפ"ק דמסכת כלים:
Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:14:1.english: And from where [would] a woman [appear] in the courtyard? - For it taught "offerings of the most sacred order"; and behold, if they take them outside the courtyard, even into the Women’s Courtyard, they become disqualified as [meat that has] left [its boundary], and women do not enter it [the courtyard], as we learned in [the chapter of] Avot HaTum’ot in the first chapter of Tractate Kelim.

Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:15:1.english: For his daughter - [Who is] a minor or a maiden.

Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:15:2.hebrew: דחקה ונכנסה מהו - וכי לא הוצרכנו לשאול בבית המדרש: מה יאמרו אם קדשה — אם קידושין הם אם לאו:
Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:15:2.english: [If] she pushed and entered, what [is the halakha]? - And did we not need to ask in the study hall what they would say if he betrothed her — whether it is a [valid] betrothal or not?

Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:16:1.english: For all your needs - And even to betroth a woman with it.

Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:16:2.hebrew: כאש - חלקו של אהרן הושווה לחלקו של מזבח: מה מזבח לאכילה, אף כהן לאכילה, ולא לדבר אחר:
Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:16:2.english: Like the fire - Aaron's portion was equated to the altar's portion: Just as the altar is for consumption, so too a priest is for consumption, and not for any other purpose.

Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:1:1.hebrew: והא מתני' בגזל דידה - דקתני שלהן היתה, ודייק רב מינה דאינה מקודשת אי לאו דשביעית הואי:
Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:1:1.english: But isn't the mishna [a case of] property stolen from her - For it teaches, "It was theirs," and Rav inferred from it that she is not betrothed were it not that it was [produce of] the Sabbatical year:

Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:1:2.hebrew: בדשדיך - מקמי הכי, (ונתרצה) להתקדש לו — דכי קבילתיה לגזל דידה בשם קידושין, אחילתיה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:1:2.english: Where he had arranged - Prior to this, (and she agreed) to be betrothed to him — so that when she accepted her stolen property for the sake of betrothal, she forgave it.

Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:2:2.hebrew: דרבי שמעון - בסדר טהרות (כלים פרק כו משנה ח), ומייתינן לה בגמ' דהגוזל (ב"ק דף קיד.): עורות של גנב אין מחשבה מטמאתן, ושל גזלן מחשבה מטמאתן; דקסבר: כיון דידע מאן גזליה ולא מצי לאגבויי מיניה — אייאושי מייאש:
Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:2:2.english: Of Rabbi Shimon - In Seder Taharot (Kelim 26:8), and we cite it in the Gemara of [the chapter] HaGozel (Bava Kamma 114a): Hides [in the possession] of a thief, intention does not render them susceptible to ritual impurity, but [those in the possession] of a robber, intention renders them susceptible to ritual impurity. For he holds: Since he knows who robbed him and is unable to recover [it] from him, he definitely despairs.

Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:3:1.hebrew: ה"ג ההוא אריסא דקדיש במוזא דשמכי - מלא יד של בצלים:
Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:3:1.english: This is the correct reading: A certain sharecropper who betrothed with a handful of onions - A handful of onions.

Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:3:2.english: Who relinquished to you - Who relinquished to you the landowner's share?

Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:3:3.hebrew: אבל כישא - אגודה, שדרך הירק להיות מתחלק באגודות, וכל האגודות הן שוות: אם נטלתי אחת, טול אתה אחת:
Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:3:3.english: But a bundle - A bundle; for it is the way of vegetables to be divided into bundles, and all the bundles are equal: If I took one, you take one.

Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:4:1.hebrew: ההוא סרסיא - עושה שכר מתמרים של בעל הבית למחצית שכר, וחבירו בב"מ בפרק המפקיד (בבא מציעא דף מב:):
Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:4:1.english: A certain brewer - One who produces beer from dates belonging to the homeowner for half the profit; and its counterpart is in Bava Metzia, in the chapter [entitled] HaMafkid (Bava Metzia 42b).

Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:4:2.english: With the sediment of beer - After he extracted the beverage from it.

Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:4:3.hebrew: מהאי חריפא - יש שהוא טוב מחבירו, שלא נתנו בו מים פעמים הרבה, ויש לו לחלוחית לתת עוד טעם במים אחרים:
Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:4:3.english: From this sharp [one] - There is [sediment] that is better than another, into which they did not put water many times, and it has moisture to still impart flavor into other water.

Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:4:4.hebrew: לא אמרו כלך אצל יפות - שיועיל למי שנטל את של בעל הבית שלא ברשות, דנימא גלי דעתיה דניחא ליה — אלא לענין תרומה בלבד, דהא לתרום הן עומדות. אבל לענין מי שנטל לעצמו — משום כיסופא הוא דקאמר ליה, דלא נכסוף, אבל למפרע לא ניחא ליה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:4:4.english: They did not say: “Go to the better ones” - [Meaning] that it should be effective for one who took the homeowner’s property without permission, such that we would say he revealed his intention that he is pleased [with it], except with regard to the matter of teruma alone, for [the produce] is indeed designated to be separated [as teruma]. But with regard to one who took [property] for himself — it was out of embarrassment that he said [this] to him, so that he would not be embarrassed, but retroactively he was not pleased.

Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:5:1.hebrew: אם חושש משום גזל - אם מקפיד בעל הבית על מה שעשה, ודומה לו שגזלה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:5:1.english: If he is concerned on account of robbery - If the homeowner objects to what he did, and it seems to him that he robbed it.

Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:5:2.hebrew: אין תרומתו תרומה - דהשתא, ודאי הכי קאמר ליה: אם מצאת עוד יפות מאלו, היית גוזלן:
Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:5:2.english: His teruma is not teruma - For now, he was certainly saying this to him: “If you had found even better [produce] than these, you would have stolen them [as well]!”

Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:6:1.hebrew: בין כך ובין כך - בין שיש יפות, בין שאין יפות מהן:
Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:6:1.english: Either way - Whether there is better [produce], or whether there is none better than them:

Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:8:1.hebrew: והא מתני' בגזל דידה - דקתני ״שלהן היתה״, ודייק רב מינה דאינה מקודשת, אי לאו דשביעית הואי:
Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:8:1.english: And doesn't the mishna [deal with] theft from her - As it teaches: "It was theirs," and Rav inferred from it that she is not betrothed were it not that it was [produce] of the Sabbatical Year.

Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:8:2.english: With his portion - That he divided with his fellow priests.

Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:8:3.hebrew: במעשר שני כו' - דקסבר ר' מאיר, מעשר ממון גבוה הוא:
Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:8:3.english: With second tithe, etc. - For Rabbi Meir holds [that] second tithe is property of the Most High.

Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:8:4.hebrew: ר' יהודה אומר במזיד קידש - דמעשר ממון הדיוט הוא:
Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:8:4.english: Rabbi Yehuda says: [If he did so] intentionally, he has betrothed [her] - For [second] tithe is ordinary property.

Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:8:5.hebrew: בשוגג לא קידש - בגמ' מפרש לה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:8:5.english: [If done] unwittingly, he has not betrothed [her] - In the Gemara, [it] explains it:

Rashi on Kiddushin 52b:9:1.english: And with consecrated [property], etc. - And their reasons are explained in the Gemara.

Tosafot on Kiddushin 52b:14:1.hebrew: וכי אשה בעזרה מנין - פי' הקונטרס: דאין אשה נכנסת בעזרה, כדתנן פ"ק דכלים. ולא דק, דלא אשכחן בשום דוכתא דנשים אסורות ליכנס בעזרה; שהרי בפרק קמא דכלים תנן: "החיל מקודש הימנו — שאין טמא מת נכנס לשם; למעלה הימנו עזרת ישראל — שאין מחוסר כפורים נכנס לשם, וחייבים עליה חטאת; למעלה הימנו עזרת כהנים — שאין ישראלים נכנסים לשם אלא בשעת צרכיהם: לסמיכה, שחיטה, תנופה", ולא קתני נשים שאין נכנסות שם! ועוד תנן בפרק כל הפסולין (זבחים דף לא:): שהשחיטה כשרה בנשים, א"כ יכולה ליכנס בעזרה! ועוד, הרי סוטה ונזירה נכנסות בעזרה להניף! לכך נראה לי: "וכי אשה בעזרה להתקדש מנין?", הרי אין רגילות שתכנס לשם כדי להתקדש, שהרי בזיון הוא, ומילתא דלא שכיחא היא, ולא איירי תנא מזה:
Tosafot on Kiddushin 52b:14:1.english: "And from where would a woman [be] in the courtyard?" - The Kuntras explained that a woman does not enter the [Temple] courtyard, as we learned in the first chapter of Kelim. But he was not precise, for we do not find anywhere that women are forbidden to enter the courtyard. For in the first chapter of Kelim (Mishnah 1:8) we learned: "The Rampart is more sacred than it, for one who is ritually impure from a corpse may not enter there. Higher than it is the Court of the Israelites, for one who is lacking atonement may not enter there, and they are liable to a sin-offering for [entering] it. Higher than it is the Court of the Priests, for Israelites may not enter there except at the time of their needs: for laying of hands [semikhah], slaughtering, and waving" — and it does not teach that women do not enter there! And furthermore, we learned in the chapter [entitled] Kol HaPesulin (Zevachim 31b) that slaughtering is valid [when performed] by women; if so, she can enter the courtyard [to slaughter]! And furthermore, behold, a sotah and a female nazirite enter the courtyard to wave [their offerings]! Therefore, it appears to me [that the Gemara means]: "And from where [would] a woman [be] in the courtyard to be betrothed?" — for it is not customary that she would enter there in order to be betrothed, as it is disrespectful, and it is an uncommon matter, and the Tanna does not speak of this.

Tosafot on Kiddushin 52b:16:1.hebrew: [וזה יהיה לך מקדש כו' - קשה: דלשתוק מלך, דמשמע כל צרכיך, ולא אצטריך לכתוב אש. ת"י]:
Tosafot on Kiddushin 52b:16:1.english: ["And this shall be yours of the most holy things..." - It is difficult: Let [the verse] omit "yours," which implies "all your needs," and it would not have been necessary to write "fire." — Tosafot Yeshanim]

Tosafot on Kiddushin 52b:6:1.hebrew: אם נמצאו יפות מהן תרומתו תרומה - התם (בב"מ דף כב.) מוקי לה דשויה שליח. וא"ת: אם כן, מאי קאמר "שלא ברשות"? וי"ל: דה"ק: מה שתורם מן היפה — שלא ברשות היה. וא"כ, צריך לומר גבי פרזומא דשויה שליח, דאי לאו הכי, מאי מייתי:
Tosafot on Kiddushin 52b:6:1.english: "If [produce of] better quality than them is found, his teruma is teruma" - There (in Bava Metzia 22a), [the Gemara] establishes it [as a case] where [the owner] made him an agent. And if you say: If so, why does [the baraita] say "without permission"? And one can say: This is what it means: That which he separates from the better-quality [produce] was without permission. And if so, one must say regarding the [case of the beer] sediment [parzuma] that [the owner] made him an agent; for if not so, what is [the Gemara] citing [as proof]?

Tosafot on Kiddushin 52b:8:1.hebrew: המקדש בחלקו אינה מקודשת - ואם תאמר: מי גרע מהמקדש על מנת שאדבר עליך לשלטון (לקמן קידושין דף סג.), דמקודשת אף על פי שלא נתן לה כלום, אלא שעשה לה הנאה? ויש לומר: דלא דמי; דהתם יכול ליטול שכר מדיבורו, והוי כאילו נתן לה פרוטה. אבל הכא, הטובת הנאה אינה משלו, דהא ממון גבוה הוא, ואינו יכול ליקח ממון מהנאה שעשה לה. [אע"ג דאית ביה שוה פרוטה שיכול למוכרה לכהן — מ"מ כיון שהוא ממון גבוה אינה מקודשת, ולא דמי לע"מ שאדבר עליך לשלטון. ת"י]:
Tosafot on Kiddushin 52b:8:1.english: One who betroths with his portion, she is not betrothed - And if you say: How is [this] worse than one who betroths [a woman] "on the condition that I speak to the ruler on your behalf" (below, Kiddushin 63a), where she is betrothed even though he gave her nothing, but rather [merely] generated a benefit for her? And one can say: It is not comparable. For there, he is able to take payment for his speech, and it is as though he gave her a perutah. But here, the right of benefit is not his own, for it is divine property, and he cannot take money for the benefit he generated for her. [Even though it has the value of a perutah, in that he could sell it to [another] priest, nevertheless, since it is divine property she is not betrothed, and it is not comparable to "on the condition that I speak to the ruler on your behalf." — Tosafot Yeshanim]
